features.quote: Provide a `submit(status, summary)` tool so models have a legitimate, low-cost exit.
features.justification_quote: without an exit hatch, even a well-calibrated model is forced to thrash.
40 gives room for degradation to emerge without exploding cost.

features.quote: Termination conditions: turn cap hit, `submit()` called, or context window exceeded.

features.justification_quote: Without it you're measuring "what does a model do when trapped with no way out"
